main_text.l: Sacramentorum effectum ministrorum sanctitati & manui attribuunt Donatista.
Sacramenta per mulieres dari posse dicunt Marcionita, Pepuziani, Papista.
Sacramenta plura, quàm Christus ipse, instituunt Papista.
Baptismum aliquem visibilem esse dandum Christianis negant Afcodruta.
Baptismum Christi nec bonum, nec utilem esse, sed suum tantùm dicunt Samofatenian, Manichaei, Arriani, Aetiani.
Baptismum Christi spernunt Pelagiani, Celestiani, Catabaptista.
Baptismum in aqua faciedum negant Marcionita, Seleuciani, Hermiani, Procliani.
Baptismi vim ad præterita tantùm peccata delenda pertinere, Messaliani, Papista.
Baptismum paruulis fidelium negant dandum Pelagiani.
Post Baptismum homines peccare non posse, Iouinianista.

page.notes: The woodcut-free page has a faint show-through of the reverse side, which is not transcribed. The line-end "baptizan-" continues on the next page. No page number is printed. "Ulum" replaces the printed capital V, and "utilem" replaces the printed "vtilem", following the u/v rule. "Samofatenian" is read as printed, though the original form is likely Samosatenian. "Marcita" and "Afcodruta" are printed as they appear, and the forms are consistent with the original.
